title: New sleeves for v8.6 not tested before (3 trials), strict rule

trials.A funding-change XS: 60-coin universe (as the wide carry), score = -(7-day mean funding today - 7-day mean funding 7 days ago): long the third whose funding FELL most, short the third whose funding ROSE most (crowding unwinds), inverse-vol legs, 7 tranches (as premium carry 60), 5 bp + funding
trials.B low-beta XS: 60-coin universe, 60-day daily beta to BTC: long the lowest-beta third, short the highest-beta third, inverse-vol legs, 7 tranches, 5 bp + funding (betting-against-beta, Frazzini-Pedersen; not tested in crypto here before)
trials.C intraday seasonality: BTC and ETH perps long during the 22:00 and 23:00 UTC hours only (literature: Bitcoin intraday seasonality, strongest returns late in the UTC day), 0.5 each, 5 bp per side, funding

rule: sleeve DEV (2020-21) > 0, TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, corr with C* <= 0.3 (v7lab.judge), AND the strict rule: v8.6 with the sleeve has every period (2022, TEST, HOLD) not lower and the 2022-26 Sharpe at least +0.05 higher
bf2.6: a trial is tested in bf2.6 only if it passes in v8.6
